items.html: And it is known that the three Mochin are the aspect of the three letters Yud-Hei-Vav. And it is known that ZA, whose Name of Havayah that includes it all, is in the filling with Alephs, which is in gematria MA. And behold, Yud-Hei-Vav in the filling with Alephs is in gematria Tal (dew). And behold, in the three Elokim that are in these three Mochin of nursing, in their fillings, as above, there are in the three of them also thirty-nine letters. And behold, how the three Names of Elokim that are in the three Mochin are also in the secret of Yud-Hei-Vav.
